results.cohort_rights: Endogenous archive retention, paid outside training/data and dated lab entry/exit now enter the same three-recipient competitive technology. 24/24 primary pure-game cases and 12 projection-off comparisons solved. With an inherited procedure 2, installed mobile and costly outside research, retention rights induce one ordinary-service archive→internal physical qualification→extra accepted job: combined wealth 347→348, jobs 12→13, customer surplus 18→21. This is a matched rights/scope comparison, not an endogenous second-generation acquisition result. Three-date positive cases fix hardware, while two-date cash/scope cases allow assembly.
results.manufacturing_rights: Endogenous kit ordering and assembly restored to the three-date rights/scope economy. All 16 matched cases solved (15 pure roots, one exact two-action mixed root with pure continuations). Installed mobile rights premium survives (+1 private tick); a paid mobile kit without installed hardware makes rights unused. With installed arm and paid mobile kit, rights displace selected assembly; under the higher-total pure continuation rule the root has no pure equilibrium across 170×170 retained profiles. Verified mixed root retains with probabilities 3/5 and 1/2, wealth (171,169.2), 12.8 jobs and surplus 22.4, versus no-right pure wealth (174,169), 12 jobs and surplus 18. Lower-total continuation gives equal private wealth (171,170) with and without rights, but rights add one job. No selected kit orders or endogenous successor acquisition in these three-date cases.

results.mixed_continuation: The exclusive S=10 gap is closed by exact intermediate mixed continuation. At nine date-two public states under the higher-total pure-first rule, certified two-by-two supports replace missing pure continuations; at the first state, lab retention probabilities are 24/25 and 3/5. Exclusive cap-1/cap-2 and alternative lower-total selection give 160 generated wealth each, 44 jobs and 88 customer surplus. Concurrent cap-2 gives 163.625 each, 42 jobs and 84 customer surplus: +7.25 combined private wealth, -2 jobs and -4 customer surplus. A local lab-retention fee interval [0,1/2] is certified against every retained action at the first mixed subgame, conditional on unchanged downstream policies and prefunding. Complete dynamic parameter-region certificates and full mixed correspondence remain open.
results.dynamic_common_kit_region: Complete-game common mobile-kit-price certificates now include every retained deviation and off-path continuation. The S=10 exclusive seed profile, with nine intermediate mixed subgames, is an equilibrium for all κ in [0,8]; the concurrent profile is an equilibrium for all κ in [0,6]. Generated wealth per firm is 164−κ and 167.625−κ, respectively. All-state direct endpoint replays pass 114,578 exclusive and 479,768 concurrent deviations at each endpoint, with dated cash/resource/hardware accounting. The upper boundaries are off-path incentive changes, not root adoption cutoffs. These certify complete-profile eligibility, not the full correspondence or persistence of a selector.

Not free redispatch, additional learning, earlier collection, binding finance, or full equilibrium correspondence.
